_comment: One entry per league you want covered. 'odds_api_key' must match a sport key from https://api.the-odds-api.com/v4/sports (run scripts/list_sports.py with your key to double check — these change occasionally). 'espn_sport'/'espn_league' are used to pull recent form/streaks/H2H from ESPN's public scoreboard API (no key required). Set 'outdoor' to true for leagues where weather should be factored in.

settings._picks_api_comment: Base URL of the Cloudflare Worker that stores your bet selections. Replace with the URL wrangler prints after 'npx wrangler deploy'. Until it's set, the checkboxes fall back to the local pick server.
